scenes.title: MAX
scenes.narration: MAX returns the largest value in a column, from highest sale to most recent date.

scenes.title: Finding the maximum
bullets: Works on numbers, dates, and text
scenes.narration: MAX scans the column and returns the largest value it finds. Like MIN, it works on dates and text too, where largest means latest or alphabetically last. NULLs are ignored, so only genuine values are considered.

scenes.title: Highest sale per region
scenes.narration: GROUP BY organizes orders into one group per region. MAX then identifies the largest order amount in each group. The alias biggest_sale labels each region's top transaction clearly.

scenes.heading: MIN vs MAX
scenes.narration: MIN and MAX are mirror images that scan the same column for opposite extremes. MIN reports the smallest value while MAX reports the largest. Both ignore NULLs and both apply equally to numbers, dates, and text.

scenes.text: MAX pinpoints the largest value, complementing MIN for finding extremes in your data.
scenes.narration: Use MAX to find the largest value in a column, and pair it with MIN whenever you need both ends of a range.
